ollama is a free tool that runs ai models locally. it includes a desktop app where you can download a model and chat with it, similar to other ai chat products.

**why run models locally?**

- **privacy** — your data never leaves your machine
- **no usage costs** — once downloaded, models run for free
- **offline access** — works without an intern

content.title: VFX and Simulation
content.description: Create realistic visual effects using simulation systems. This specialization covers particle systems, fluid dynamics, rigid body physics, cloth simulation, and dynamic effects for film and video.
content.searchText:
vfx and simulation create realistic visual effects using simulation systems. this specialization covers particle systems, fluid dynamics, rigid body physics, cloth simulation, and dynamic effects for film and video. understand the principles and techniques used in visual effects (vfx) and simulation develop proficiency in using vfx software for creating realistic simulations of natural phenomena (e.g., fire, water, smoke) learn to integrate vfx elements seamlessly into live-action footage gain knowledge of particle systems, dynamics, and procedural generation techniques explore the role of compositing in combining vfx elements with other visual layers analyze and critique vfx sequences to identify effective techniques and areas for improvement 
this specialization explores the technical and artistic aspects of creating visual effects through simulation. students will learn to harness physics-based systems to create believable dynamic effects for film, television, and other media.

## lessons

physics, particle simulation, match moving, compositing
content.author: Michael Collins
learningObjectives: Understand the principles and techniques used in visual effects (VFX) and simulation
Develop proficiency in using VFX software for creating realistic simulations of natural phenomena (e.g., fire, water, smoke)
Learn to integrate VFX elements seamlessly into live-action footage
Gain knowledge of particle systems, dynamics, and procedural generation techniques
Explore the role of compositing in combining VFX elements with other visual layers
Analyze and critique VFX sequences to identify effective techniques and areas for improvement
